description: Import video, audio, images, fonts, SVG or JSON from a direct URL into the private workspace library. Returns a durable asset ID and verified contentHashSha256. Fonts, SVG and JSON are limited to 25 MiB.

contentHashSha256.description: Optional expected SHA-256; mismatching bytes are rejected before deduplication. 64-character hex string.

projectId.description: Optional project ID to associate the upload with. UUID string.

url.description: URL of the media file to download and upload

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID when projectId is not provided. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

name: media_import_url
title: Import Media From URL
